thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT - model artifact fetch errors from Hugging Face (429 rate limits)

incident-bot: Severity: P1 (partial availability) — several hosted model fetches failing during cold start. Auto-alerting to #incidents and on-call.

tayler (oncall): I’m looking. Seeing spikes of 429 on model downloads (hf.co). CPUs on fetch workers are fine, but retries are spiking and causing queue pileups. Rolling a hotfix?

morgan (sre): Confirmed. Grafana shows a 5xx/429 increase from hf artifact CDN starting 11:08 UTC. Cache hit rate for local artifact proxy dropped from 98%->67%. Cold-start requests are timing out after 30s.

samir (eng-runtime): Root cause likely HF throttling outbound artifact downloads. We already have retry/backoff but it's linear and aggressive on concurrent cold starts. Suggest changes: 1) exponential backoff with jitter, 2) circuit breaker per model, 3) hard cap concurrency for cold-fetches, 4) prefer local quantized fallback images if available. Can ship patch to runtime in ~20m.

elena (support): We’ve got 2 customers pinging support with increased latency/errors on text-generation endpoints. No data loss. ETA messaging?

ryan (product): Prioritize customer comms for accounts on Dedicated—some have SLAs. Can we provide a temporary mitigation message to affected customers?

samir (eng-runtime): Pushing a minimal hotfix now to change retry to exponential backoff + 5s min, cap at 8 attempts. Also adding jitter and turning on per-model circuit-breaker (trip after 10 consecutive 429). Patch diff excerpt:

```
# runtime/fetcher/retries.py (pseudo)
RETRY_POLICY = {
  "initial_backoff_s": 5,
  "max_attempts": 8,
  "strategy": "exp_with_jitter"
}

# circuit breaker: fail after 10 429s in 1m window
```

incident-bot: samir has been assigned as incident engineer. Pager escalations to SRE.

morgan (sre): While patch builds, mitigation plan:
- Reduce concurrent cold-starts: set env var COLD_FETCH_CONCURRENCY=6 on fetch pool
- Increase local cache TTL to avoid eviction for recently used model ids (1h -> 6h)
- Use fallback smaller model family for new cold starts if primary fetch fails (fallback chain)

samir (eng-runtime): I’ve got a canary rolling in us-west-2 with backoff + circuit-breaker. Will monitor error rate and P95 latency. Canary config:
```
curl -X POST https://console.internal/redeploy -d '{"service":"fetcher","env":"canary","config":{"backoff":"exp_jitter","circuit_breaker":true}}'
```

incident-bot: Canary deploy started at 11:23 UTC. Notifying on-call and runtime.

morgan (sre): HF support ticket opened (ticket# HF-84721) — their status page shows elevated CDNs rate-limiting unauthenticated artifact requests. Recommending token-authenticated pulls and lower concurrency. Link: https://status.huggingface.co/incidents/84721

elena (support): Draft to customers: "We’re seeing intermittent model load failures due to third‑party artifact rate limiting. We’ve applied mitigations to reduce error rates and are working with Hugging Face for a long term fix. If you see errors, retry later; for enterprise/Dedicated customers, we can pre-stage your models."

ryan (product): Send that to affected accounts + account execs. Also offer pre-stage option as temporary SLA concession if needed.

samir (eng-runtime): Canary metrics are promising: 429s reduced by ~70% for canary nodes, P95 cold-start latency down 40%. Rolling to 25% of traffic now.

morgan (sre): Lowering COLD_FETCH_CONCURRENCY on prod to 6 now. Also adding short-term heuristic: if model fetch returns 429, mark model id as backoff until next successful fetch + 10m. This prevents stampeding herd.

incident-bot: Update: patch rolled to 25% at 11:33 UTC, 100% rollout started at 11:40 UTC.

hf-support-bot: HF Support: "We're seeing a regional rate limiter misconfiguration; we've increased token-based quota for your org and are pushing CDN fixes. Monitor ticket HF-84721 for updates."

tayler (oncall): Post-mortem action items so far:
- runtime: make exp-backoff & circuit-breaker permanent + config flags (samir)
- infra: artifact proxy cache sizing + TTL review (morgan)
- product/support: communicate pre-staging option and update SLA playbook (ryan/elena)
- ops: introduce warm-up prefetch for high-usage model ids before deploy (samir/morgan)

morgan (sre): Logging/observability follow-ups: add metric hf_artifact_429_count by model_id, and alert if >50 in 5m. Also capture fetch latency histograms during cold start window.

elena (support): Customers notified. One Dedicated customer accepted pre-staging. Others asked for ETA; we'll update after HF confirms resolution.

samir (eng-runtime): Final rollout complete at 11:51 UTC. Error rate back to baseline by 12:05 UTC. Closing incident when metrics stable for 30m.

incident-bot: Incident moved to "mitigated" at 12:06 UTC. Postmortem assigned to samir + morgan, due in 3 days.

tayler (oncall): Thanks team. Leaving a note in #postmortems when draft is ready. :thumbsup:
